description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractMqttClientActor that handles MQTT client connections, subscriptions, and messaging within an actor-based concurrency framework, likely using Akka actors. It manages the lifecycle of MQTT clients, connection testing, reconnection logic, and starting/stopping consumer and publisher actors.

classes.name: AbstractMqttClientActor
classes.description: An abstract actor class for managing MQTT client connections, handling subscription and message publishing. Defines lifecycle and connection management mechanisms, abstract methods for client creation, disconnection, and starting publisher and consumer actors.

classes.name: AbstractMqttClientActor.MqttClientConnected
classes.description: Inner class representing a successful MQTT client connection event, extending AbstractWithOrigin and implementing ClientConnected.

classes.name: AbstractMqttClientActor.Control
classes.description: Enumeration for control messages to manage reconnection behaviors, including RECONNECT_CONSUMER_CLIENT and DO_RECONNECT_CONSUMER_CLIENT.

methods.name: createSubscriptionHandler
methods.description: Abstract method to create a subscription handler for MQTT messages.

methods.name: sendConn
methods.description: Abstract method to send a connection request to the MQTT broker, returning a future with the acknowledgment.

methods.name: disconnectClient
methods.description: Abstract method to disconnect a specified MQTT client, returning a future when complete.

methods.name: startPublisherActor
methods.description: Abstract method to launch a publisher actor for MQTT messaging.

methods.name: startConsumerActor
methods.description: Abstract method to start a consumer actor for MQTT message reception.

methods.name: doInit
methods.description: Performs initialization steps, primarily creating MQTT client and subscription handler.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Lifecycle hook for cleanup, disconnecting clients and calling parent postStop.

methods.name: reconnectConsumerClient
methods.description: Handles a request to reconnect the consumer client, potentially restarting the client after a delay.

methods.name: doReconnectConsumerClient
methods.description: Performs the actual reconnection logic, disconnects old clients and creates new client/subscription handler.

methods.name: resolveMqttClientId
methods.description: Generates the MQTT client ID, defaulting to connection ID and appending instance ID if necessary.

methods.name: resolvePublisherClientId
methods.description: Generates the publisher client ID, considering optional config overrides and connection ID.

methods.name: createClientAndSubscriptionHandler
methods.description: Creates MQTT client and subscription handler, handling exceptions by resetting state and notifying self.

methods.name: createSubscriberClientAndSubscriptionHandler
methods.description: Creates the MQTT client and its subscription handler.

methods.name: resetClientAndSubscriptionHandler
methods.description: Resets MQTT client and subscription handler references to null.

methods.name: doTestConnection
methods.description: Tests MQTT connection using a temporary client, running subscription and connection steps, then cleaning up.

methods.name: doConnectClient
methods.description: Handles client connection by starting publisher and consumer actors, then subscribing.

methods.name: clientConnectedInConnectingState
methods.description: Handles MQTT client connection event, triggering subscriptions and connection acknowledgment.

methods.name: subscribeAndSendConn
methods.description: Subscribes to topics and sends connection request with delay, to ensure ordered startup.

methods.name: sendConnAndExpectConnAck
methods.description: Sends a connect request and waits for CONNACK, with specified delay.

methods.name: handleConnAck
methods.description: Handles the CONNACK response or throwable, returning initialization result.

methods.name: connectPublisherClient
methods.description: Connects the publisher client if configured as separate, or returns completed future.

methods.name: allocateResourcesOnConnection
methods.description: Placeholder for resource allocation after connection establishment.

methods.name: startConsumerActors
methods.description: Starts MQTT consumer actors and returns success status.

methods.name: startPublisherActor
methods.description: Starts the publisher actor.

methods.name: doDisconnectClient
methods.description: Handles disconnection procedure, with logging and cleanup.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the MQTT client, throws if not initialized.

methods.name: getSubscriptionHandler
methods.description: Returns the subscription handler, throws if not initialized.

methods.name: appendInstanceIdForNonEmptyClientId
methods.description: Appends an instance ID suffix to the client ID if multiple clients are configured.
